title: Domain entry bench and procurement signal collage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a targeted bench and qualitative probe to map how emerging entrant models behave across three domain pockets (legal summarization, customer support RAG, and financial Q&A) and surface procurement-ready signals for Private/Dedicated customers. Goal: deliver an evidence collage that links (1) observable latency/cost/quality tradeoffs from small-scale synthetic workloads, (2) integration friction and ops runbook items, and (3) procurement trigger heuristics (when to prefer reserved capacity, hybrid, or hosted). This ticket coordinates field bench runs, vendor compatibility checks, and cross-functional interviews to produce a short decision pack for sales and procurement.
acceptance_criteria: Bench matrix with per-model latency, token-cost, and top-3 failure modes for 3 domain workloads (CSV + summary)
Integration friction scorecard (0-5) with recommended mitigation per friction type
Procurement trigger canvas: clear thresholds for recommending Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private with example customer profiles
One-page decision pack and a 12-slide rebuttal deck for sales, plus a linked PRD in Confluence
